html:
Let’s join Vietlook Travel to check out the famous attractions in Ha Long that you should visit at least once in your life such as: Sunworld Park, Bai Tho Mountain, Tuan Chau Island, Dau Go Cave, Hang Hang Sot, Ha Long Bay, Thien Cung Cave, Hon Ti Top… let’s review the attractions in detail.

Sunworld Park

  • Coming here, visitors will be able to participate in exciting games that will bring visitors the most perfect experience when traveling to Ha Long with games
  • thrilling games at Dragon Park
  • Typhoon Water Park
  • Queen cable car to admire Ha Long Bay
  • Sun Hill
  • Bao Hai Linh Thong Tu spiritual complex
  • Sun World Beach

It can be said that this is one of the international-class parks in Ha Long, including 2 main areas: The coastal entertainment complex and the entertainment complex on the top of Ba Deo, connected by the most modern cable car system.

Bai Tho Mountain

One of the limestone mountain systems, tilted to the ground to avoid natural erosion, creating a mid-level landscape, from the top of the mountain you can see the vast landscape.

Tuan Chau Island

A paradise for travelers because of its wild and majestic beauty surrounded by overlapping mountain ranges, the green of trees and leaves, the blue of the sea creating a beautiful natural picture, a stop chosen by many tourists every summer.

Dau Go Cave

Known as a mysterious cave, coming here visitors will visit the famous attractions that nature has bestowed upon this place.

Sung Sot Cave

One of the largest caves in Ha Long Bay, coming here visitors will discover the mysterious beauty, admire the beautiful stalactites, visitors can record beautiful pictures for themselves.

Hon Ti Top

Tourists should experience a cruise to admire the beauty of the bay, when passing through the famous sights, visitors can admire the scenery right on the 5-star Ha Long cruise, which will bring visitors the most perfect vacation in the island paradise.

So let’s join Vietlook Travel to Ha Long tour today, to visit and sightsee, experience the feeling of sitting on a cruise gliding through the waves will be the most enjoyable experience, especially visitors can also enjoy fresh seafood right on the cruise.
